note: Cast time, delay, cooldown and requirements of every skill in the sample jobs' trees, quest skills included, at every level, for level 99 players of three builds with every tree skill learned and nothing equipped. The first classes record their whole tree. Second and transcendent jobs record the skills that no earlier job recorded. Dancers and Gypsies are female. 'players' lists the learned skills of each player of a later job. 'cast' is skill_castfix followed by skill_vfcastfix in renewal or skill_castfix_sc in pre-renewal, as unit_skilluse_id2. 'heal' is skill_calc_heal of the skill on the caster itself: 'forced_min' with rnd_force_min, and the lowest and highest of seeded rolls.
